I am reviewing this item of Lingerie called plus sized by C.C. Beauty. I received this lovely negligee at a deeply discounted price in exchange for an unbiased opinion. I give this item five stars for the following reasons. My opinions are not influenced by price. All comments are my own, valid and I stand by them.

This is very flattering at home date night attire for the woman wearing it and for the man she is wearing it for. I ordered mine in the pink, my favorite color. The fabric is soft and stretchy, being made of elastane/cotton, so it is not too warm nor does it cause you to perspire. I find it interesting that this article of nightwear is referred to as plus sized.Right now I am somewhat larger than a size twelve, but I have been burned by Asian sizes before so I ordered an XXXL, just to be sure it was not too snug. It is a comfortably loose and flowing and hangs a bit longer on me than the picture on the product page indicates, which is fine. It just looks that much nicer a bit longer. The fit seems to be appropriately gownlike rather than form fitting, which is best suited for 20 something women with thin, toned bodies.

The material is not see through, except for the mesh at the neckline, plunging slightly toward the cleavage, and at the upper back, which makes it sexy and mysterious, not excessively revealing so as to lend the body a sense of mystery. The mesh and the hem, which has a zig zag shape, is edged with pretty lace, a wider lace at the hem. Particularly attractive is the peekaboo (open hold showing skin) effect of the upper arm/shoulder on the dolman-like flowing sleeves. This is a truly comfortable and sexy negligee, a combination I have not often found in my collection of nightwear. I actually like sleeping in this gown. The neck edge and the open upper sleeve are edged in stretchy satin material which is double stitched.

The fabric is easily washed out in the sink, and dries relatively quickly when wrung out in a towel first. It also does well in the washing machine with like colors on a delicate cycle and gentle drying. There were no wrinkles from being in the package. Crunching the nightie up in a ball for a while and hanging it up, and still no wrinkles.

This is a must have for your negligee collection ladies. Everyone should have a nice bit of pink for the boudoir, and I think this is just the one to buy. It is not terribly expensive, looks nice on, washes and dries easily and should last for a long time.

Further full disclosure: if my review is positive, it is because I honestly think highly of the item, as I do with this 5 star review. I depend on quality reviews when I buy on Amazon, so I take the review process very seriously. If my review assisted you in any way with your decision to purchase, please click "yes" that you find it helpful.

In conclusion, I will be shopping in the C.C. Beauty storefront the next time I am looking for an addition to my lingerie collection. And did I mention that this item is also very reasonably priced? You can order yours in one of three colors.

First my wife laundered the black shirt in the washing machine on the "gentle" cycle, and dried it in the dryer on a cool cycle, common for use with cotton.  The out come is as shown in the photo:  perfect. For the next "test" I washed the white shirt by hand in luke warm water in the bathroom sink, which i sometimes do with my workout shirts.  I hung the shirt on a regular clothes hanger in the shower to dry. I let it dry thoroughly, then put it on for photos. The white shirt photograph attached is as it dried:  perfect.  So in sum, I'd say these fit me as an extra large, very closely.  I normally would expect to wear a LARGE in western sizing, so X-large is OK, but I would prefer my shirts to be just a bit larger.  I do not believe a 2X would fit as well as the X-large. Finally, the quality of the fabric is extra good and for the price, I recommend these shirts as an OUTSTANDING VALUE.

It's a lovely jacket, but the proportions are very odd.

I had to check one of the preset boxes for the fit, and I chose "Somewhat Small" but it is misleading. The general size is fine, but there really needs to be a "fits odd" option for mis-made clothing like this.

Like many manufacturers of plus sized clothing, Ulla Popken seems to have completely forgotten about arms.

Many manufacturers will take a regular sized garment and resize it larger, but take no notice of the size of the arms. We are left with garments that fit our bodies, but are ridiculously snug against the arms.

A loose, gauzy jacket should have reasonably loose arms. This one does not. They are TIGHT.

I am a fairly proportional woman. I do not have popeye arms. The sleeves in this jacket are very, very snug. If you look at the picture, snug arms do not really fit the look of this garment. I am perpetually baffled by this choice in garment designers. Is fabric so very expensive that saving a few millimeters on arm sizes makes a profit difference? Or do they just assume that larger women just swell up in the middle like balloons and maintain slender limbs?

The arms are also significantly shorter than they appear in the picture, hitting barely below the elbow, with the snug lace making bending difficult. I am tall, though, so perhaps on a very short woman they would be the right length (as long as her arms are much slenderer than the rest of her body).

Or maybe on a tyrannosaurus. The arms are perfect for a tyrannosaurus. If you are carnivorous, green, large, and have teeny little arms, I strongly suggest you grab this right away. It was made for you!

Let me start off by saying I own eight watches of varying levels of cost, from entry level to luxury pieces, and I've purchased quite a few watchbands, either as replacements or as an accessory when I don't want to wear one of my steel watches on the bracelet.

I typically buy deBeer straps as I find their quality to be exceptional for the money, but I've seen a lot of positive feedback on Hirsch, so I decided to give this one a try. Maybe it's because this is one of their more entry level straps (they have premium alligator and croc bands that are several hundred dollars), but I found the quality to be very poor.

Let's start with the most glaring flaw, the pin buckle. It's one of the cheapest feeling I've ever seen. It's a tinny and flimsy thing, so much so that it barely felt like actual metal. I've purchased silicone watch bands from places like Barton at half the cost of this band with a pin buckle that would put this band to shame.

The band itself looks attractive enough at a glance, but the tactile feel of it is one of incredible cheapness. The bottom of the strap feels like cardboard, and the top feels rough and scratchy to the touch. It's a stitched band rather than bonded, which I prefer, but there's precious little bolstering added.

I recently purchased a genuine crocodile strap from deBeer for about the same cost, and the pin buckle and construction were leagues better than this.

Overall, I would not recommend at all, especially if planning on pairing it with a higher quality timepiece. Maybe their upper end straps are better made, it's certainly possible, but the quality of this one (or lack thereof) would have me thinking twice about ordering another one.

These shoes are a good buy for the money.  They perform as a good cycling shoe ought to.  The platform is solid, and the uppers offer appropriate ventilation. The overall construction is well above average. I would have given them five stars but for the fact that they are rather narrow in width, as are the majority of China-made shoes that I have come across.  If you have a narrow foot, then they will suit you very well, but anything other than that, it will be necessary to use a shoe stretcher, or endure discomfort on the bike.  You'll need to be patient with the stretching process, as the synthetic material the uppers are made of is resilient and tends to return to the original shape shortly after they're out of the stretcher.  I have been stretching mine for over a month and by now they are quite comfortable.  The size chart offered by Shimano is accurate.

So, I work way too many desk hours, and, while I am endeavoring to take more frequent breaks, and even bought a little stepper machine to use in my office, research on health led me to compression socks. given that I've got a bit of neuropathy setting in, which is not good. I was pretty surprised at the prices, and, of course, it's hard to know if the "knock off" brands are any better than "branded" brands. Since I knew nothing of compression socks, it's been a hit and miss of trial and error.

I wanted something white (not sure what's up with so many compression socks coming in wild color combos and designs?) and, starting out, I eventually found some great copper infused compression socks on here, by FuelMeFoot, that are 15-20mmHG which was a good beginning (and three pairs for ten bucks is awesome!). Then, hot weather hit, and it's very difficult to find a regular athletic or crew length sock to wear with shorts (wasn't really wanting to rock the lederhosen look, haha), but, finally found some from ADLU. Of course, a shorter compression sock doesn't do the same job, and I get that, but the ADLU are a nice balance of looking like "normal" socks plus providing some compression benefit and, at 15 dollars for two pairs, it's not that bad, since regular socks have gone up in price, yet seem to have gone down in quality at the same time.

But, having gotten used to (and actually really liking) how compression socks feel, I wanted to notch up to a more therapeutic level of compression, that I could wear while sleeping, at least a few nights a week, so I started exploring brands of those type. Read the many great reviews for these, but, with seeing much less expensive options, I tried those first, just because 20 bucks a pair is steep.

I ordered one of these, to compare, and, NO comparison, these are definitely the BEST of what I've found. The level of padding, and comfort, and excellence of fit is phenomenal. Extremely well made socks, and they just feel wonderful to wear. I know, kind of odd, socks that feel so great, but, seriously, these make my feet and legs very happy. I sleep great, and it seems my neuropathy is not getting any worse, and may even be starting to improve, so three cheers for compression socks, and a thousand cheers for these Wanderlust socks, the best of what I've found thus far, in a higher compression sock.

They even sent a coupon for my next order, and I just ordered two more pairs. They are thicker than the FuelMeFoot ones, so I'm not sure they will work as well in my sneakers, but, as an around-the-house and sleep-at-night sock, these are awesome. If they don't make my shoes fit too tight, I will likely switch over to these when the weather warms up, and possibly wear these exclusively, since they offer more therapeutic effect.

A terrific sock, and thanks to all the reviewers on here for sharing their findings. Wish I'd had these when I used to do overseas travel, but glad I've found them now!

SUMMARY: Well made, perfect fit, plenty of padding, "normal" appearance, super comfortable, and, in a case of getting what one pays for, these are worth every penny. Highly recommend!

For the right kind of person, with just exactly the right sort of style (or appropriate lack thereof), the Casio F91W is every bit as good as, if not better than, a Cartier. Th F91W is a classic. It's remained virtually unchanged for decades, and there's a reason for that. Certainly, it has its own look. It's slim, sleek, and sports the cleanest of clean lines. It's simple, and it doesn't make a big fuss. It's comfortable, it's accurate, and it does enough. Its alarm is positively reliable, and its stopwatch is simple and consistent. It's small and unassuming, and doesn't draw a lot of attention to itself because it doesn't need to. This watch exists for its wearer and no one else. It doesn't try to impress, but it will never let you down. It does a few things and it does them well, all the while, not pretending to care at all about the things it doesn't do.

It's a perfect watch for a woman or a man, for a child or an adult. It's good for sport, and it's good for relaxing, and it's good for work, and it's just fine for everything else in between.

If this watch were a person, when asked the time, it would reply "quarter to three!" with a big grin on its face, and go back to its drink without missing a beat. It wouldn't huff and fumble for the time and act as if you were intruding on it before somehow giving you a time that was an hour too fast or slow.

But you knew that already, didn't you? It used to be that you could find an F91W accidentally, just out shopping in the department stores. And maybe you'd need a new watch so you'd pick one up. But today, and especially online, the F91W doesn't really find you as much as you go looking for it. You wouldn't be looking at it if you didn't already know it was perfect for you. And if it's not the watch for you, that's fine too, just move along to something else. The F91W isn't bothered. It knows who its people are.

For a suit to be priced at under USD$100 is surprising to be, even after having purchased 2. Soon w was going to his senior prom in North Palm Beach, Florida and wanted to wear a nice suit. After going to the large high quality department store with the big red "M"and after visiting the different men's suit clothiers, we took to the internet. We had 14 days before prom and he was on the prom court and up for King so he wanted to look very nice. He's 17, lean and athletic, 6'1",waist 34",inseam 30",dress shirt size large or 16" collar and 32"arm length, and weighs about 160lbs. He needed to buy a suit, liked that the fit was slim, and decided to go with the navy /blue suit. We ordered on a Friday night and received on Monday.
He purchased the size 40R. Suit is shipped promptly and properly. Unless you're a tailor or know of someone who can sew, you'll likely need basic alterations as the pants arrived u hemmed so they can be tailored to fit the gentleman and his style, some like a little sock showing and others prefer it longer or the bottom cuffed. We went to a local tailor and he measured my son without the suit on and with it on. The jacket fit perfectly and the kid looked like a model standing there in the small shop in the mall. The vest also fit nicely but my son wanted it a little tighter for a look that was more streamline and fit looking. The waist had to be taken in to size 34", pant length reduced to match his 30" inseam. To measure your inseam, take your best fitting pair of pants or jeans and lay them flat on the floor. Measure from the inside crotch all the way to the bottom of the pant leg. That's your actual inseam.
For about $30 they fixed the page length, shortened the waist to fit him perfectly and with with room for an undershirt and dress shirt on, and tailored the buttock area to more firm fitting than the baggy feeling he sensed. The tailor said young men are used to shorts and jeans and not dress pants and they often feel baggy. We picked the suit up in 2 days and he tried it on with the tie and vest, along with a nice pair of oxblood leather Colehan shoes and he looked incredible. He looked better than he liked in suits by Tommy H and others that were well over USD$400. My son thought his seat might be too tight and the tailor told him to not wear baggy boxes, rather he would wear briefs or compression shorts so the look would be smooth and sleek.
Prom went off without a hitch and he was chosen as prom king. I ordered the very same suit for myself in a 42R and only needed the plant length adjusted. For over $139.00 Josh looked like a movie star. Don't forget the cool tie and pocket square. Even dad looks great and we're both thinking of a reason to try another style from this same maker.

I now have three pairs of this brand of pants and love them all. I have the 22" in Gray, a full length pair in Black, and then HAD to have this flamboyant and beautifully colored pair, as well. These pants perform so much better than even the most expensive brands for my high-intensity cardio 5 days per week as well as weight-training and just a jog/run/walk on weekends.

The fit and feel is always just a little better than everyone else's. They never fold over or ride up/down during exercise, they always keep my muscles warm and compressed, and they NEVER show embarrassing thigh/crotch/booty sweat through the fabric unlike a $70 pair I bought from a high end store. Even the lighter prints and colors don't show your sweat and dry super-fast under the sweatiest conditions. They sit fairly high, but not too much that you can't adjust them lower or pull them up a bit to suit your preferences. The fit it is right on point, the stretch stays super-strong, and they LOOK GOOD. I always love the way these look. The other brands I have are "last resort" pairs I wear when I'm low on workout gear and haven't done laundry yet.

The waistband is much thicker and higher than others and stays put no matter what. That is my peeve is waistbands inching down, moving around, or needing to be adjusted once they're soaked with sweat or you're in an awkward position. These move with your body like a second skin and are just thick enough that you never feel "exposed"....but not so thick as to feel cheap or difficult to move around in.

They wash REALLY well. I wash my workout clothes constantly and these hold up to a few washings per week and I even put them on the hottest dryer setting with zero issues. *Never use fabric softener on workout clothes or they may not wick moisture anymore* so I throw 1 Cup of White Vinegar in with my workout clothes and these come out soft and static-free. Some cheaper items I own are always covered in static. The colors haven't faded or bled on any of my pairs, seams are strong, and elasticity/compression is like brand new.

I highly recommend these and will continue buying my 4th....5th....(etc) because all of the others have fallen short for all-around excellence. These are awesome whether you're a runner, a yoga fan, a cardio-junkie, or a lifting queen. And you can afford to have a fantastic outfit everyday of the week that washes and dries easily, too! These are the best workout pants out there.

I'd LOVE to see them add some more mesh styles to their pants in a broader range and am waiting patiently for it....but in the meantime, I'd rather skip the mesh and keep buying these because I've learned my lesson buying other brands. You won't regret your purchase no matter what you're buying them for!

Excellent Quality, Perfect Fit, Rivals My Designer Brands!

Awesome Purchase! Perfect Fit!

These are right on-point for fit. So don't worry about size up and down or "muffin top" or any of that. I actually ordered these not noting the Brand and then went to *name-brand, big-box store* to see if they had reasonably priced workout clothes the next day and ended up trying on 3 different pairs of Power Flex pants that all fit perfectly and seemed better than even the CK and Nicole M. sets I have/tried on! I realized when I received these via Prime today that these were "that same brand" and breathed a sigh of relief knowing they'd fit well before I even put them on.

To be clear....I am about a Size 10. I'm 5'7 with a 34 Large C Chest and pretty "normal/average" thighs and butt in relation to my overall size. I buy a "Large" in bottoms, typically because I'm "long in the thigh" and have problems with regular sizes not being long enough for my crotch -->knee area. So I ended up sizing up or buying "talls" hoping to not have a crotch that's 2 inches below my actual body. These are PERFECT for long legs!! The length is awesome in that it's hard to find this length in-stores because they mostly label only "Capri" and "Regular/Full" lengths and you have to scavenge for this length. I love it that they're still long enough that I don't freeze in the Winter and Fall, but can still wear them in Spring and Warmer Weather.

I know waistbands are really important to pretty much every woman. I'm using these for regular working out at the Gym as well as Physical Therapy for my back which means a Therapist is grabbing my body parts and flexing them for me (so you don't want super-wild pants and a weird fit both because therapy can be painful and because it would be embarrassing if butt-crack or muffin-top came out....you want WELL FITTED pants for this, trust me). These are perfect for both!

*PLEASE NOTE* In my photos I left the tag on the pants to show that these are genuinely branded and marked properly and didn't realize that the tag was actually folding the waist-band down a bit. It's actually "smooth" all around. The band is thicker and double-seamed around the upper belly and these are about "medium-rise". You could probably yank them up to make them a bit higher, but they honestly fit JUST right. There is the built-in "pocket" on the front-inside of the pants just like Nicole M. and other more expensive sets you may be used to. The band is flattering, but not too tight. The back is high enough for any butt no matter how large or small it is. The band leaves plenty of "length" so that there's no areas that you'd need to worry about even doing an extreme work-out or running.

Most of all, I want to make clear how amazingly soft these are....but somehow thinner/more natural feeling & durable than other brands. I don't know what it is or how they do it....but these feel more like "second skin" than any other brand I've tried lots of Designer Brands. Normally if you want "durable"....you get the really heavy/hot/thick pants that are less flexible. If you want "thinner" and "cooler" you get pants that aren't durable and shift around on your body. Somehow these are the perfect mix of both. They feel soft and "medium" thickness....but are still cool and super-flexible. But like the thicker blends, they stay very secure in the waistband and other areas and can handle tough workouts and stretching with no problem.

And on a side note...I wasn't sure about ordering the "Charcoal" but they are a perfect heathered grey and they really look great with any of my bras, tees, and cover-ups because they are very neutral and look amazing on. My photos are "meh" as far as getting the color and fit using the selfie-cam, but you really only need to buy a pair of these yourself to find out that these are amazing quality and will make you forget your designer sets in favor of these. Excellent value, perfect fit, sizing on point, and amazing comfort and flexibility/durability! I highly, highly recommend these no matter what your preference or fitness demands!

Let me start out by saying that I love purses. I have so many of them that I lost count. I long ago gave up on my quest for the perfect bag. Either they are too big or too small. There is always something that I wish the designer had thought of, but I learn to work around it. This is part of the reason I have so many. If it doesnâ€™t really meet all my needs, I look for a new purse that relieves the aggravation of my old one. But then? That one comes with its own problems. It can be a never-ending cycle.

As soon as I opened this package, I fell in love. The color and feel of the leather is wonderful. The smell of fresh leather as soon as you take it out of the bagâ€¦ (yes, I may have a small addiction, haha!) It is the perfect size for me. It is roomy, but not overly bulky. I love that.

But it doesnâ€™t end there. The thought that the designers put into this bag is astounding. It can be used as a clutch, a wristlet, or a shoulder bag. That alone is impressive. But it is the little touches that really won me over.

There is a large, roomy compartment that would be perfect for paperwork (no more creases). Inside, there are 3 pockets. Each of the pockets is lined with an elegant and smooth lining. One of the pockets has a smaller zipped enclosure, there are two sets of card holders, and a larger zipped enclosure.

The zippers are smooth but sturdy. They really did think of everything. This purse negates the need for a separate wallet, though a wallet would fit perfectly inside.

I love that it is a small bag that can hold lots of stuff. It is deceptively roomy on the inside for how sleek and small it looks on the outside. With all the pockets, it is easy to keep everything organized as well. No more rummaging around in an oversized bag to find what you need.

The quality of the purse is second-to-none. It is beautifully stitched with color-matched thread. The leather is gorgeous. Even the zipper pulls give it the look and feel of a much more expensive bag. The strap is flexible but strong, and it is comfortable to wear. It doesnâ€™t dig into the shoulder when you wear it as a shoulder bag.

This bag will replace so many other bags. It is much nicer than any of my more expensive bags. The simple design is so sleek and stylish. I have already received a lot of compliments on this bag. If you are on the fence about whether or not to purchase this, I would encourage you to go ahead and do it. You will not be disappointed!

Several years ago I purchased a pair of very expensive gold threader earrings.  I have carpal tunnel syndrome in both hands and needed earrings that were easy to put on. Once I managed to get my tiny gold hoops back in my earlobes I had not taken them out for the past five years.  Then I saw the product description of the Milacolato Threaders.  It claims you can sleep with them on - even take a shower and they would stay in.  I was willing to give them a shot.  And it turns out the product description was correct.  I have slept in these;  I have showered wearing these;  and I have changed clothes without knocking one or both of them out of my ear lobes.  They are delicate and light weight - I don't even know they are in my ears.  Even better, three neighbors who have seen them on me commented on what beautiful earrings they are.  I have owned these earrings for 24 hours.  I hope they last for 24 years! Love them.

I have traveled pre-covid all over with this bag, I have thrown all sorts of items into it, I hang it on a hook every night out of dog reach, and nothing has broken at the zipper or any of the seams. The handles have stayed firmly attached and the backpack straps are literally not going anywhere.

For those curious - it can easily hold a Nintendo Switch in a hard case (yellow item in the picture) with no issue and plenty of room to hold all your other items like a wallet, keys, phone and a power bank without straining the zipper. You could probably get a small laptop, and I mean, small, in there? Definitely my iPad. Even with everything shoved into it, I don't have much problems with it resting on my shoulders for too long (like if I spend a day walking around town) - it's pretty comfortable with weight distribution (I'm 5'7 and 31 years old).

Note when the backpack is a bit full, you may have trouble getting a water bottle or travel mug to fit in the side pockets. I usually just shove my chapstick and inhaler in those side pockets anyways, or a spare roll of dog poop bags.

I haven't truthfully tested the water resistance - given all of my electronics I keep in it I always keep an umbrella on me when there's a chance of rain.

10/10 I'd buy this bag again (if and when the one I have now ever bites the dust).

I purchased this watch in Japan, before Amazon Prime offered it on its site.  Had it been offered earlier; I would have purchased it from Amazon as a Prime member.  This Citizen CC3081-52E is a beautiful watch, in and out.  While I usually prefer watches with a blue face, my sustained and focused view of both the black face, compared against the blue face ($100 more) model of this watch over the web led me to the conclusion that the black face with the white luminous hour and minute hands, as well as the red second hand and the minute white day of the week sub-half dial hand, would produce a crisper and cleaner appearance.  I was right!  This watch is a beauty in both a casual setting; as well as when worn in a formal setting.  And the subdued, hard coated duratekt carbide coated case and bracelet (4 times harder than regular Titanium), combined with the 99% clarity coated anti-reflective sapphire crystal make for an exceptional pairing.  Add to that, the mechanism is "chocker-block" full of capabilities, even though it only has one sub-dial, half reflecting the days of the week and the other half reflecting the degree of charged power.  It updates time, date, etc. via GPS from the satellites on a scheduled basis; but a minimum of once every six days or sooner, if worn much outside.  And when it is stored in darkness, the hands stop moving to save energy, but the mechanism keeps perfect time.  Once you take it out into the light, the hands and date immediately readjust themselves to the correct time/perpetual calendar. Or, you can do so manually, only taking 3 to 30 seconds to do so.  And the other two atomic watches I have, a Seiko Coutura SSG020 and the Citizen PCAT CB5908-57E (both purchased from Amazon) that are on atomic time in the same time zone all show exactly the same time, within a second of this Citizen GPS CC3081-52E.  Very neat to see the second hands turning at exactly the same location on each watch.  But this new Satellite Wave watch is my favorite.  An added plus is that this watch only weighs 3.6 ounces due to the high-tech Titanium band and case.  I know with certainty because I weighed it myself on my wife's kitchen scale!  The band also has a minimal adjust mechanism built into the clasp. Therefore, if it is not quite tight enough, but adding a link would make it too tight, the minimal adjust mechanism shores it up just right.  I love the simplistic beauty of this watch, and the "V-8" under its proverbial hood.  You will too!

Inside, there are slots for cards (credit cards, loyalty cards, insurance cards, etc.) plus a plastic-front pocket for your driver's license. There's room for cash, plus a zippered pocket for coins (it's a little difficult to get to this pocket, and it's hard to find the coins you want without dumping them all out).

The big negative for me is how little this wallet holds. I usually carry two credit cards, plus a number of other cards I might need. I filled four of the slots in the wallet, inserted my driver's license, and placed the other cards in the pockets behind the slots. Then I put in my cash and coins, folded up the wallet, and snapped it shut. Unfortunately, it was hard to snap it shut and the wallet felt too thick and bulky.

If you want something to hold just a few cards and little else, this might work. But the feel of the wallet changes greatly once you fill it up. I was hoping to like this, but I think I'll stick with my larger, easier-to-use wallet.

I ordered this dress in the mint green w/ large white flowers, and in the 'multicolor 2' black dress with purple and dark pink small flowers. The two dresses are really different, even though both are the same size. The 5 stars is for the green dress. I would give the black one a 3. (*The specific differences between the two are listed below)

The overall effect of the differences is that the black one seems like something a southern republican grade school teacher would have worn in the early 90s (I seem to recall a few outfits like this from my elementary days), while the green one has a timeless, artsy, bohemian vibe. I do think the black one can be styled in ways that are cool & modern (despite its inherently uncool look), but the green one is ACTUALLY cool & very pretty.

I'm keeping the black one to use as a 'beater' dress for events where I want to wear a flowy dress but don't want to care if it gets dirty or even ruined--sitting on grass/sand/rocks/etc., walking in mud & wet grass at festivals/outdoor parties, sitting around smoky campfires, frolicking at the edge of the sea, etc. (all of which are more fun in a flowy dress--especially one that you don't mind messing up!) But the green one is perfect for more 'civilized' things like... pretty much anything else where you'd want to wear a pretty long flowy dress... but especially brunch. This is basically a perfect brunch dress. If you like brunch, get this dress, is what I'm saying.

Also, some people said that the lighter colors were see through but the mint green one isn't-- when I first tried it on I had navy blue shorts underneath and you couldn't see them at all. I'll probably wear a skin-colored bra & underwear to go in public, but I was afraid that it would be much more sheer than it is. (However, you can probably see an outline of your body if there is a bright light behind you).

Lastly, the only thing that would make this dress better (the green one anyway) is POCKETS. Why oh why aren't there any pockets in this???? You wouldn't even see them and it would be so convenient.

*The differences are: 1) the green sleeves are cut & sewed in a way that is more subtle & nondescript, the black sleeves are very very poofy; 2) the green one is a bit shorter, especially in the front & back (more of an asymmetrical hem that is longer at the sides), whereas the black one is floor length all around; 3) the green one is lower cut at the top, showing a hint of cleavage, and the black one is higher cut; 4) the black one has a string tied on the front that makes a long bow with tassels at the end, the green one does not have this. Also obviously the colors and patterns are different.

This is a great watch strap. However, 2 months later it's starting to split down the center because it's essentially layers of leather glued together. For those who don't know, "Genuine Leather" is actually a classification of leather. It's the cheapest and less durable leather. It's often made of layers put together. Top Grain leather is the next best and next most durable. It's not actually on the top, but I didn't come up with these terms. It's a good mix of split and full-grain leather. So the best and most durable leather is Full Grain leather. It's the thick leather closest to the animal's hair and it goes deep into the Top Grain area. It's denser, stronger, and natural. Like top grain, it's one single piece. Sometimes full grain leather is sanded down and thinned out to look perfect: no blemishes or scars at all. This is great for high-end purses and watch straps. I wish this strap was Top Grain. It would last longer and not split. For $20, I think that would still be profitable but they chose the CHEAPEST leather here.

It's rare to find a smaller minimalist wallet that meets all a person's individual needs. Because of this simple point, only you can decide if this is right for you. The benefits of this wallet is it's compact, durable, holds about 6-7 cards, and has a band for folded money. The negative or concerns I've come to find are also the band and if it will hold up over time, the fit is too tight to have any card in a protective sleeve, and its simplistic design is so barebones basic that it's not very convenient.

Update:
The elastic band has now begun to lose much of its elasticity and is fraying which is basically what I figured would happened so no surprise there. I'm going to give Trayvex a try. A few of their products offer a lot more features, more storage capacity, easy replacement part change-outs, and at a reasonable price. I hold about 8 cards (license, LTC, 2 job cards, 2 credit cards, debit, and AAA) between personal and job related needs so this just doesn't cut it for me. I think many people would find themselves in a similar boat. However, there's nothing misleading about the product. It will likely never break and the only worry is the band that will need replacing here-and-there for long term use. Plus the band is always shifting and sometimes falls off which will lead to everything coming apart. Good luck.

ORIGINAL REVIEW: So incredibly disappointed with this purchase, which was eventually returned. I only really wore it for about five days, until it started to "fall off" from coming undone on its own. I knew when I first put it on that the snap closure didn't really feel like a good snug "snap." The two sides that actually slide into the fitbit tracker device itself worked just fine. However, the part where the silver snap part went in never felt like it snapped. I even tried taking my silver button from my original fitbit brand band, but it still felt the same way; as though it never really snapped in. This leads me to believe it is an issue with the actual holes in the band itself. I loved the color, it was exactly what I was looking for, but I can't risk losing my actual fitbit tracker for the sake of a preferred band color. Buyer beware.
Also, it appears that it now comes with the slide rectangular piece - this did not come with it when I made the purchase originally. I did return this item after about a week due to the inefficiency.

This is cute, functional and stylish. I transferred all the stuff from my other purse easily to this one, It is a smokey see thru plastic with imitation alligator skin accents. The strap can be either a cross body or as an off shoulder purse, both work easily with the strap being adjusted to your preference. It has a twist closure that matches the golden chains on the strap. I can clip my keys to the D ring on the purse where the strap attaches, I feel confident this purse will last quite a while. Some employers require purses that are see thru, this fits the bill. This purse stands up without me being too concerned that it will fall over as other purses do. The base is built for it to sit up.
My only concern would be losing items if it accidentally got knocked over. I would not use this for travelling on an airline, with the metal accents and potentially losing important items in a airline checkpoint. There is a soft inner purse, for ladies essentials or monthly cycle needs, keeping them nicely discreet. Overall I think this is cute and functional, will use on date nights. I think this can be used with confidence by a vast age range as well.

Turning them inside out, here my assessment, the stitches are nicely tensioned, meaning tight adjusted.  The borders are well designed, but the border at the heel has about 14 elastic  stitches, and just half would be enough, since they're well programmed/positioned.  The clear rubbery application at the heels is also well designed and manufactured.  The seam above the toes is noticeable but it shouldn't be an issue, unless your shoes, like the loafers, or snickers have a seam just above it to cause extra pressure and potentially some marks on your skin.  The elastic in the middle of the socks has loose ends and this will only cause problems if you cut them, especially the one closer to the toes, so don't do it.  The best feature, those socks don't add much volume inside the shoes and stay in place as expected.  The package came with an extra pair. I got 9 pairs instead of 8 as the link informs, 3 black, 2 grey, 2 beige, 2 white.  I really liked them, regardless of the imperfections.

"Oatmeal Heather," is the same exact color as CafÃ© Au Lait. What could possibly be a better color for a comforting throw? The UGG DUFFIELD throw is gorgeous and lush. This is a color which would go into any dÃ©cor quite easily and is obviously easy on the eyes. I find comfort simply seeing it thrown across the sofa awaiting our next encounter!
My kitties, not even knowing what warm CafÃ© Au Lait is, are drawn to it. It must feel AWESOMELY soft on their soft padded toes for they ALL want it as their very own substitute mama (original or ME!).
This throw is long and wide, allowing for coverage from my neck to OVER the toes unlike skimpy, frustrating throws! The sewn on UGG tag lets you instantly know which is the length side versus the width side. So don't cut that tag off; it will come in handy a thousand times.
Now, why am I more satisfied with THIS throw over every other of the many, many, many throws I have bought through the years? After all, I have had 100% cotton throws, microfibers of many brands (even from apparently barefooted people in California, if you get my drift!), and cashmere throws. But yes, THIS throw is THE one, my FOREVER throw. It is the DRAPE of this throw which is delicate and lets if give uniform warmth. It is a constant, every square inch of your body, legs, and feet getting a uniform, soothing warmth. Now, that may sound strange. I have back surgery caused neuropathy from my knees down in both legs. This throw drapes into every curve with a lightweight warmth. It is difficult to describe how DIFFERNTLY wonderful this throw is. It is NOT hot. It seems to KNOW how much warmth to give you with hardly a feather-weight feel. No, I am not saying this is an ultra-light throw, for it is medium/light in weight. But it KNOWS where to go in its drape and what to do, draping soothingly everywhere it touches. IT FEELS GOOD! Not strange, just the facts.
I have NEVER found a throw I simply want to keep the tips of my fingers running back over and over again simply to feel its soft touch. It reminds me of my favorite teddy bear from when I was a child.
And another thing: this throw doesn't get all nappy when washed either! YEA! Some fibers clump together and begin to look ratty in microfiber throws, especially the so-called Sherpa ones.
Wash on warm (on delicate) alone, with no other items. And this material just doesn't hold stains! Use NO softener as it will clog up the fibers. Dry on delicate with NO dryer sheet. Now, IF it were to get static electricity in the winter, dry with about one-fourth of a dryer sheet and that will do the trick. The border doesn't shrink and the feel of the throw is better with each wash. And that border is SUBSTANTIAL and doesn't get all bunchy or shrink at a different rate than the rest of the throw and it is well sewn onto the throw. The border is part of what makes this throw worth the money. The hem isn't simply part of the thrown turned over and sewn upon itself as is done with lesser cost throws. This border gives the throw a place for you to have complete control over where the throw lands when you throw it out over your body. And then the supreme pleasure of it begins.
Look, I've gone on and one like I don't have a life. The whole point is that this is the best throw money can buy and I KNOW that for a fact (99% sure). Uniform warmth. Medium in actual weight but never not enough and never too much. CUDDDDDDDLY material without any match in the world regardless of price. Great size for even the tallest of people.....Is this a splurge for some? Maybe yes, but then again, NO! This is ONE ITEM FOR WHICH YOU GET YOUR MONEY'S WORTH AND MORE. And it's yours F-O-R-E-V-E-R!!!

I ordered the safety ear muffs to try with my son that in on the autism spectrum. He gets so frustrated with noise that he can't think straight at times. Although he can use his regular headphones and music to tune things out, we would like him to also start trying to tolerate a little bit of life around him. These worked wonders for that. They muffle the noise but do not completely block it out. He can sit in the living room with us while reading a book, but still be able to pay attention and hear the conversations we are having. Sometimes now, he will even take them off and join into a talk about something that interests him. Before, he would have the music so loud to tune everyone out, that he rarely talked to any of us. I tried these myself as well. They make it sound like you have your hands tightly covered over your ears, but I can clearly still hear the kids and what is happening around me. If you are seeking complete silence, that is not what you will get from these, but for our needs they are perfect.

I received the safety ear muffs free for evaluation and honest feedback. My review is based solely on my experiences using the headphones to muffle normal, everyday sounds.

Update 11/21/2016:

Shortly after above post the company reached out to me and shipped a replacement belt. Belt arrived and was in perfect condition. Quality control might be lacking at times but customer service is excellent. I did not expect anything in return and did not ask. I did not plan to return original belt. One might ask why... Well one question asked was if it was usable as a gun belt and figured I would give it a shot.

As a gun belt this is what I can say. In waist belt functions excellent. Thickness of belt combined with compression from body and versatile tension from buckle provides all that is needed even with a double stack full size pistol.

Outside belt is trickier. The thickness can support the weight of a full size gun but the width is going to give you some play. You will have to chose a holster made to be used with a standard belt. Smaller guns worked best because less tension was needed to remove from holster however the larger guns you could feel the belt shift while drawing unless you tightened the belt beyond reasonable.

Bottom line If the your looking for a nice belt I think you can count on this brand to deliver. If your looking for a nice dress belt for conceal carry this belt does work quite well IWC but OWC you will have to chose the gun and holster more carefully.

However, I easily snipped the felt that was showing with regular scissors, and I'd say I was able to pick off 95% of the hot glue so that you can't even tell there was ever a problem. Like I said, for the price, these were a good purchase for my baby girl to wear!
Opened box, frowned, closed box, returned. I think they are made out of cardboard.

This is a very pretty set, great for daytime wear if you like a little shimmer during the day.  It doesn't exactly sparkle, it has more of an opalescent gleam, which makes it lovely for day wear imo.  I especially like the color, it's a warm, rosy pink which would be flattering on any skin tone.  It would make a nice stocking stuffer, too!  It's lightweight and very comfortable, and it has a lobster closure so it's easy to add an extender if you want.  It's a fun set, a not-too-huge bib necklace that is a bit understated.

I got the 'Colorful' selection, and it's exactly that...colorful!  I love lots of color, so this choice is perfect for me.  The colored stones are rather large, and the colors are very vivid.  There's a ring of round, bright turquoise stones on the inner edge,  then goldenrod yellow oval stones mixing it up with large fuschia rounds.  There are some clear rounds thrown in for extra sparkle, and a few metallic findings that enrich the overall look. This is a true collar-style necklace, and it fits me like an 18" necklace, and that's using the extender.  Because of the construction, you won't be able to add more than about another inch because it won't lay correctly if you do.  If you like longer necklaces then this piece probably isn't for you.  But if you love fun jewelry, if you like to be the star, if you want all that delicious color up by your face....come on in, the water is fine!  This would be a great piece to wear to a block party, casual day at the office, or just to go to the grocery store.  It would be pretty on a jewel neckline sweater, or in an open collar of a shirt.  It would also be a great gift for the little diva in your life.  At this price, it's no big deal if it gets lost or broken.  The only 'flaw' for me is the way the clasp is attached.  There is very little room between the end of the necklace and the lobsterclaw clasp, so it's awkward to get a good enough grip to open it and latch it onto the chain.  Because of that, this is a four star rating.  But, it's great for what it is...playful, colorful, inexpensive, and showy.  I'll be wearing this a lot come spring!

This necklace is stunning! The blue is the color of the most brilliant shade of turquoise you have ever seen, only it's lit from within. This is the type of jewelry that I wear for day. I would go a little funky and wear it with jeans, or a pretty skirt and sweater set. But it would be amazing at a formal occasion like an evening wedding, or a dinner dance. On prom night it'll make all the other girls jealous, trust me! Turquoise looks fab on everyone, so give it a try.

The quality is good for the price, especially since it comes with earrings. It has a lobster claw closure, so you can adjust the length and even add an extender if you like. Over a bulky sweater, you may need to. It does seem a bit fragile, so handle with care: Keep it stored flat (NOT hanging) and wipe it down with a damp cloth after each wearing, and that should be all you need to do.

For those who love rhinestones like I do, I give this item a full five stars, and ten if I could! Give it a try...I think you'll love it!

First off, this is such a sexy/beautiful costume, I have yet to find another one that is also this cute! My 21st birthday is this October so I wanted a halloween costume themed party and fell in love with this costume! I ordered it about a month and a half early just in case I needed to send it back for sizing- good thing I did! I'll explain below.

2nd, I normally wear a womens US Medium Tshirt, size 11-13 jeans, and I'm a 36D. I originally ordered this costume in a size medium thinking to go along with my tshirt size. It came in quick shipping, and I tried it on. I mean, it did fit on my body, but it was just a little too tight for my liking. I wanted comfort for throughout my party, and I didn't love how it showed off all of my curves and flaps just a little to much. I am not "curvy" so I don't have the cute body type where a skin-tight suit is never a question. I just have love handles every 4 inches and I wasn't feeling my greatest in the medium. As previous reviews have said, and I will attest, is that this piece is advertised as "no see-through" when in fact it's a *little* see-through. Again, previous reviewers have warned about and I will attest to, the zipper can be a little tricky to get up. A trick I used was to zip it up a few inches before putting it on, and then it's easier to zip up when it's on and already zipped a few inches. Problem solved.

But I still went through the process of returning it, which I have no issue with because I've returned amazon items before. Amazon's returning process is the easiest thing I've ever dealt with. (Props to amazon!) So I went to my local UPS Store, and got my refund in a matter of a few hours. Then I proceeded to order the large. It said it was going to take about a week til delivery, it was here in 3 days. So again, I'm impressed with (and appreciate) the quick delivery. I tried on the large and I'm in LOVE! It fits so much better, comfier, doesn't suffocate my body, and accentuates my best features (though I dont have many lol). It's stretchy & pretty breathable. I just love everything about this costume. I'll detail each pro & con of the costume:

Con 1: Just fair warning, whatever t-shirt size you wear, and depending how tight you like your clothes, you might want to order a size up. The large still hugs my body but not as suffocating as the medium. The zipper came up a lot easier on the large than the medium, but I still used that few inches before putting it on method. Worked great. When I had the medium, there were plenty of stretched lines in the costume which was another reason I decided to order a size up. The large still had some lines showing but it's not anything that would ruin the look of the costume.

Con 2: The headband is pretty weighted, so I might have to use bobbi pins or something to hold it in place. (I'm just wearing it on my own hair, not a wig like some others have done.) But honestly this headband is SO cute, and I've got a solution for the weight. So is it really that much of a "con"? Don't think so.

Pro 1: this is seriously the cutest halloween costume I have ever seen. The pink fluff on the front is SO soft, and the tail is so adorable. The headband just completes the costume and I love it!

Pro 2: it was seriously fast shipping. Both times. Maybe it's just where I live vs where they're based out of (which I dont know off the top of my head) but both times the costume beat the predicted delivery dates. Fast delivery, 'nuff said.

Pro 3: If you take into consideration the reviews telling you how to choose your size, it's just an amazing costume hands down. It's not super off-sizing, which to me is a rare thing. So I was happy to find this size a better suitor for me.

Pro 4: Ladies, get yourself some gold high heels if you can wear them! The gold bottoms on the legs look FIRE with high heels. Ugh this costume is just so sexy!

Sorry for writing a NOVEL in this review, I just wanted to clearly explain sizing for future buyers, and tell them just how happy this costume makes me. Happy Halloween or whatever the occasion it is that you're wearing a costume!

Update: I wore it for my party and OMG it was comfy the entire night! The party lasted about 8 hours, and I stayed in this costume the entire time. Got so many compliments on it!

While it is nice to search for my phone or wallet on command, I quickly found myself disabling it. For whatever reason, the wallet losing connection with my phone often via bluetooth. Honestly, if this were a vertical wallet and could adjust the do-not-disturb settings, I would rate this higher.
PROS-
1. Able to manually search for phone or wallet.
2. Alarms go off on wallet and phone when bluetooth connection is lost.
3. Can take a picture with your wallet, sort of neat I guess.
4. Can see where wallet is/was on map in the app.
CONS-
1. Alarms go off on wallet and phone when bluetooth connection is lost. Bluetooth connection is intermittent even when phone and wallet are inches apart.
2. The horizontal card pocket layout make the very center of the wallet super think and the edges super thin. NOT FLAT.
3. No way to customize when the "do not disturb" time frame.
4. End up turning off features due to intermittent connection.
5. Bulky.

This fit to the size chart listed, so get the size you are comfortable wearing. We all have the recommended size to wear then we have the size we like to we whatever that might be. Some like the security of feeling things snug against the body, some feel trapped, so they like it looser fitting. As far as the function of the period lining, these I would say are for your light to med light days. I would not use these for overnight or heavy days. If you are one with a heavy flow you may need to use another product and wear these as a backup. I got these for my daughter for just that reason. On her heaviest days, when she's working, she often cannot get to use the facilities for hygiene care. These give her the peace of mind that No overflow will happen.

But as for sleeping they do not come up high enough in the back nor are they thick enough to wear alone unless it is for the light days.

You could use it for nighttime sweating for those of us getting older. One less area of the bed soaked through. Or if you have had children, coughing and sneezing can be dangerous no matter how many Kegel exercises you have done. You could wear these for those unexpected events.

Just don't think that these are going to get you through the heaviest days alone and I think you will be pleased with these.

Anyway, back to the ring itself... It comes in a beautiful and well made box - something you could easily present to someone and not feel like a cheapskate. It also comes with a small microfiber cleaning cloth in case you don't already have about a million of those floating around your home. Then there's the ring. Looking down on the ring, it is quite beautiful. The center stone is pretty large, about a centimeter across, and is surrounded by smaller stones. The band is also surrounded in small stones except for the very bottom of the ring where it is a solid band. Because the stones are inset in the band, it is fairly thick. It's not so think that your fingers can't close around it, but it may take a little getting used to. My biggest concern is that, due to the size of the main part of the ring, it sits pretty high up off the finger. I mentioned the round middle stone is about a centimeter across and the whole thing sits about that high up from the top of the band. I would say it is definitely a show piece and may cause some problems if you work with your hands much at all. It's a bit too big for my wife so it may not get worn much so I took one star away for that. I took off the other star because, although the ring feels well built, the center focal part is a little twisted. It's not too drastic, but if you're looking at it from above, the band isn't really perpendicular (I think that may be the first time I've used that word since my geometry classes) to the middle. It is just off enough where it's a little hard to notice, but once you know it's there, you can't unsee it. Even so, the price of the ring seems very reasonable. It's not a ring for everyone, but if it matches your style, I don't think you'll be disappointed.

Wool is the best natural fiber for activewear. Let's give these wool socks by Merino.tech a try.

What's good:
Crew/mid-calf wool socks for a wide variety of uses. I'd use them for hiking, snowboarding, skiing, sledding, etc.
Decent quality merino wool and fabrication.
Wool fiber is superior to polyester/polypropylene/synthetic fibers in terms of warmth, breathability, less odor retention, and repelling water.
Fits true to size: L (9-12) fits my size 8 feet almost perfectly, with slight room to spare in the heels. That's alright because even processed merino wool will shrink slightly after washing.
Easy care: hand/machine wash, line dry.

Drawbacks:
Wool socks cost more, are less durable than synthetic fibers, takes longer to dry, and are vulnerable to moths if not washed after use.
Socks have medium thickness and are not suitable for temperatures lower than 40Â°F.
$29.99 (Mar. 21, 2023) for one pair of wool socks is too high. Competitors sell 2 or 3 pairs for approx. that price.

This is a review of MYTO's release of DON GIOVANNI conducted by von Karajan, starring Eberhard Waechter, Leontyne Price, Elisabeth Schwarzkopf, et al.  Some of the Amazon reviews associated with this item are obviously for other recordings.  To start with the negative, the sound on this recording is boxy and mono, with some fading when the singers turn away from the mike, and a bit of distortion in the louder passages; but it is still quite listenable. That said, it is a splendid performance, well cast from top to bottom. Leontyne Price was of greatest interest to me, since she never recorded Anna complete. She is altogether splendid, fudging none of the runs or coloratura, ringing out wonderfully for "Or sai" and, of course, her voice is incomparably beautiful.  Schwarzkopf's well-known and well-documented Elvira finds her at the top of her game; yes, there are still those odd vowels, but it is a fervent and febrile performance, not to be missed. Sciutti is reliable and pleasing as always. Later years would see Zerlina given to heavier and darker voices, but I like her young, fresh sound.  Panerai is a fine Masetto, and Zaccaria a suitably sonorous Commendatore. I prefer a darker bass voice for Leporello, but Walter Berry sings the role wonderfully, and matches well with Waechter's familiar and excellent Don Giovanni.  Von Karajan has the measure of the score, naturally, and conducts a very galvanic performance.  All in all, a thrilling release.

I was looking forward to receiving these cufflinks and was very pleasantly surprised when I opened this package up. First off the packaging is quite good - each cufflink comes in an individual small plastic bag, and each of those bags is inside a larger plastic bag, along with a soft velour black carrying case. This ensured no scratches or damage would come to the cufflinks.
If you liked the look of these cufflinks in the pictures, I can confirm that the do not disappoint in person. The edges between the blue and metal stripes are very clean and straight, which contribute to the high class look of these cufflinks. I will say that the pictures make stripes appear to be sky blue, but in person its more of an iridiscent blue. This does not matter to me and in fact I think the actual colour is much richer and more handsome, and it could also be due to my monitors's settings.
The cufflinks are made of a base metal, however they have a nice heft, which means they are using a decent quality grade. All the surfaces are incredibly smooth and polished, and it has a true chrome look, rather than a cheap plasticky shine. The contact points of the hinges and connector bar are very sturdy and neatly applied, you don't see any welding spots or melted metal.
In summary I am very impressed and would definitely recommend these cufflinks to anyone.

I own about a dozen Casio digital watches (I'm kind of a collector) and this one is tied with my G-Shock DW-5600E as being my favorite.  Casio makes and sells tons of F-91 watches for a reason, and have done so for a long time. The beauty of this watch is that it is so light and thin that it almost becomes a part of your body and you forget that it is on your wrist. At the same time the F-91 is quite accurate, reliable, and sturdy considering it's super low cost. Even if it does break, which would require significant abuse, the low price means getting a new one is painless. The batteries on these things will last a good long time. As far as accuracy, my F-91 actually does much better than my DW-5600E. The style isn't for everyone but I personally love the retro look. The only down side is that you don't want to be caught in a warzone wearing one because ownership of an F-91 could get you accused of being a terrorist bomber and sent to Gitmo. That aside, for anyone who wants an inexpensive and / or retro style watch the F-91 is the clear choice.

When these wear out, assuming they hold up, I'll just buy a new pair!! I'm pretty heavy, so I have to pop at more for my footwear to hold me up appropriately. These really seem like they're up to the task! Very well built. Really happy so far.

This key organizer is more large than it is smart. Realistically, it cannot hold more than five keys without stressing the bolt and stud, which would be very difficult to screw in. The clasp is nice, but it is too small to conveniently latch on and off of another key ring, such as a vehicle fob, compounding this problem is large amount of wasted space below the keys. I was hoping this would help organize my keys so they don't tangle in my pocket, which it does, but at the expense of filling excess room in my pocket. Maybe the key holder would perform better protecting a vehicle key/fob, but in all, it is cumbersome and unwieldy when looking for a specific key. The clasp and its leather connector get in the way when I'm trying to find a key, which seems silly with only five keys, but it still happens. The leather is nice in appearance, but not supple to touch, so the key holder is not quite as luxurious as it looks. The button and the contrast stitching are stylish and unique, but not in an "Etsy" sort of style, more of a machine-stamped & dyed with minimal human interaction-style. The button spins and it does not feel fitted or of significant quality.

A significant flaw in the design is the stud. It has no notches or grip to be tightened into the bar, so unless I use some cushioned pliers (to avoid scratching the stud), preventing the stud from automatically loosening is all but impossible. Other reviewers have commented on this problem, which can result in the holder spilling keys.

One nice function, given the bar and stud design, is the holder affords leverage with locks, but that is only after I spend time searching for the correct key and it's not like this feature is exclusive to this key holder.

Just received this little gem. I wanted to remove my flexible metal watch band so that I could clean it in my ultrasonic device.

It took me well over an hour plus some penetrating oil but I got it off and cleaned.

The reason for the oil and the length of time was that one of the spring loaded pins that connects the band to the watch had become frozen due to the dirt build up inside the pin assembly and would not budge. I was applying so much force to this little tool I really expected it to bend and/or break. It didn't.

As a note to anyone else, think about getting a set of new pins (measure the old ones; they are all different) prior to removal. Definitely a time and aggravation saver.

I had this model watch back in the 70's... It was very reliable and never gave me a problem, I never gave it a thought. I recall a model I bought by Casio with the outside temperature indicator. Now a discontinued model, if you have that model in your dresser drawer, it is now worth over $250, without the wrist band.

IN THE BOX
You get a well packaged watch on a holder for shipping and instructions. Put these instructions in a place that you won't lose them. It seems everything comes with some sort of instruction and most the time, they are lost or thrown away. You may need these instructions sometime in the future.
BATTERY LIFE
The battery life is well over a year, depends on how much you use the dial light which is incandescent.

FUNCTIONS
Time, Alarm, StopWatch, Date, Hourly Chime

MY THOUGHTS
This model was great and where some watches had a problem with the wrist band cracking, I don't recall a big problem with the wrist band.
... I like having the hourly chime set. The hourly announcement is loud enough to hear in a quiet room but won't interfere with any meetings.
... This watch was introduced in the 70's and was a hit. It was a reasonably priced watch in a world of what I considered overpriced watches.
... Today, the store where I bought it has closed.

MY RECOMMENDATION
I whole heartedly recommend this Casio watch if you wanting a reliable watch with the hourly chime, alarm, a stopwatch and time with date function. Be aware the dial light is not LED so it uses quite a bit of the battery each time you use it. This has proven to be a very reliable watch and lasts for years, even after battery changes. Well worth the cost.

I love these gloves!  I have ordered over a dozen pairs of gloves in the past 3 years trying to find a pair that could keep my fingers warm on sub freezing hour long morning walks in the woods with my dog.  I have tried battery operated,  lithium rechargeable,  Northface brand gloves and mittens and many other brands promising warmth.  None delivered until I tried 0zone -30 brand. These gloves are the best I have used yet.  Comfortable fit, a little bulky just like all other "padded" gloves but these actually keep my fingers warm better than my $100 lithium battery powered gloves.  I am not sure what the difference is but I do notice that if I take my hand out of the glove for a few minutes that when I put it back in the glove still feels warm on the inside. The outer soft cover of the glove remains cooler during wear and these two experiences indicate to me that the glove is holding in its heat much better than all of my other gloves.  I have not had them out in wet weather yet so I cannot comment on the waterproofing qualities but as hand warmers they have won me over. Again, very comfortable fit and the wrist sleeve is a nice touch.  While it doesn't matter to me as I generally wear them in the woods, the one time I had them out at work I had several positive comments on their looks.  The only caution that I have is that like many gloves I feel that they run a bit small.  I usually wear large and I purchased XL just to be on the safe side and they are comfortably snug.  I  am planning to order a 2XL pair soon.  They were out when I checked last... I guess the word is out!

Ms. Cthulhu says "I like these in the Fall" and I believe she's right to like them. The EBMORE 3-pack, provided by vendor at a tremendous discount as a 'for review' set is ideal socks to wear in weather that's not too hot but not too old either. The cotton is responsible for softness, the polyester guarantees no shrinkage and the spandex makes these socks well fitting. As for the 'looks', see the pictures at Amazon's page. It's exactly what they look like so there was no reason to add my own.

The 3-pair set comes in a sealed, reusable bag and they show 'size' in US, EU, UK units as well as centimeters. They includes washing and care instructions, disclose the fiber mix (70% cotton, 25% polyester, 5% spandex) and they include a statement that says: "Protect the Earth. Cherish the Environment" which, speaking for myself only, it's what I do all them time.

The BUREI Military Watch was provided by vendor at a tremendous discount, as a 'for review' item.

It's a men's classic look watch set in a military theme: green dial, green nylon straps with an inside leather lining, oversize hands for easy time reading. By design, it's super-easy to set. Of course, it doesn't know the time and, if you are in a military, you will have to remember that twenty-two hundred hours will show as ten o'clock on the watch because it's a 12-hour dial and that can't be changed. The advertised 'luminous' quality relies on phosphorescent hour marks and hands but, as we all know, you trigger a little bit of a light effect only after you expose the watch to some light source and it doesn't last for too long so... it's there but you won't be able to tell the time on a dark night unless you had some light source.

The watch comes in the traditional BUREI packaging which includes a 'gift-ready' and even a gift box with the words "BUREI - The Relentless Pursuit of Perfection" on it.

I am reading this a 4 stars because the 'luminous' in the product's name might suggest that there might be a way to light up the dial to tell the time in the dark but this is not the case.

I have never used a neck gaiter before and now see that I should have been using one for years.

While it's common knowledge that much of our body heat is lost through our head, I have to think that much is also lost through our neck now that I've used this product.

I kid you not, once I put this on, it felt like my body temperature went up a degree. It is amazingly comfortable and I believe makes all the difference in keeping warm when Jack Frost is nipping. I wore it while trail riding a 4 wheeler in temps that hovered around 22 degrees. I had a neoprene face mask to keep my face protected but I truly believe this product was instrumental in maintaining my overall warmth/comfort. I ended up taking off my face mask since between this and my wool watch cap, I was more than warm enough since I never exceeded 25mph.

No doubt on my Harley I'll still need the neoprene face mask for highway speeds but will make damn sure I'm wearing this whenever I ride in the cold.

For the record I am adult, the adult face masks don't generally fit me. I'm not sure what kind of mutant hulking adults these masks are for.

There was an article that came out recently that neck gaiters somehow were worse than wearing a mask at all. Although I'm not sure how they reached this conclusion or what they cited as being the issue I feel like this mask has a bit of an advantage over normal neck gaiter masks. I didn't notice this when I ordered it but it actually has built in ear loops. I think one of the issues with neck gaiters, at least with me, was that they would fall off, and shift around, and the constant touching and sliding actually makes things more dangerous. There is no way that this could slide off due to the ear loops. The ear loops fit me well because as I said, this is a child's mask and adult masks don't fit. This also creates a tighter fit than most neck gaiters which I like.

The bottom is open but not flapping around aimlessly. I also wear an ionizing necklace most days I go out so the fact that it's partially open is a bonus as the ions can get in.

The material is this synthetic somewhat stretchy material. If it's stretched you can see little lines in the pattern, and actually a bit even if it's not stretched. But I'm actually kind of impressed at how much detail is there. I got the cute one with the space background and the cats with unicorn horns and it's actually incredibly detailed. I am a big sucker for the "Space cat" themed items so this was a no brainer for me.

So note that when you're buying this this isn't so much a "neck gaiter" but a circular wrap with ear loops. If you get bothered by cloth around your neck, it doesn't really have much in back at all.

I love these harem pants! The pattern is wonderful & the rayon fabric is super soft & lightweight without being too transparent, plus, they have a soft & comfy, slightly gathered jersey knit waist band. They are beautiful & comfortable, dress them up or wear them casually!

For fit reference, I'm a standard U.S. 5'6", 150 lb female, & I bought the size L, just in case they really shrank from washing, plus, I've been bed ridden lately, so I needed them to be slightly baggy & roomy, for comfort, not clingy. They fit me slightly more loosely than I expected so I may wash them in warm water to try to shrink them a bit more. They fit slightly more loosely than the ones on the model in the listing. I probably could have gone with one size down. The waist is very gently stretchy & comfy, not binding at all. The ankles are also gently elasticized, right now, since they are a bit too big, they fall over my heels, but, as I mentioned, I'll just try to shrink the pants a little bit in warm water ; )

After I first received them, I gave them a quick seam check for any loose seams or flaws (they looked slightly larger at this point), then I hand washed them in cool water, with Woolite, thoroughly rinsed them in cool water & hung them up to air dry. The colors do run the first time they're washed & the fabric does shrink, but this fabric is expected to do that, so do be prepared & don't be surprised. After this first wash I launder them, inside a mesh lingerie bag, in the washing machine, using cold water, on the gentle cycle, then hang them to air dry & they come out just fine. The rayon fabric is moderately thin but not as thin as some other harem pants I have & they aren't really see-through when worn, so flesh toned under garments are just fine. The fabric is very smooth & wonderfully cool on hot days.

So far, I haven't had any issues with any seams coming out or tearing or anything else. These look well made & are very elegant, easily dressed up or worn casually. Again, the fabric is slightly thicker than some of the other, almost handkerchief thin rayon some harem pants are made of (which I also own). I'd gladly buy from this company again : )

BOTTOM LINE: These innovative readers are pretty slick. The idea of 'floppy' non-traditional bows might seem odd or intimidating but truthfully you hardly notice after a while, and they work! Slight yellowish lens coating is supposed to reduce eye fatigue for computer users. I love 'em so far. In fact, I ordered 2 more pair: 1 for work and another pair to keep on my nightstand for bedtime reading. 5 STARS

THOUGHTS: It was time to go up a power on my readers... again! Ugh. I was going to order another pair of the current readers I currently have when I saw these in that section of Amazon's web page that says "Customers who viewed this item also viewed", so I clicked on it. They do look odd with those rubbery bows but I liked the classic rimless design. And the more I looked at them the more I liked the idea of flexible bows with no traditional hinges. I have had older pairs that broke or wore out and were so loose as to be basically unusable. So, I took a chance and ordered a pair of these unconventional readers.

First impression was of respectable build quality. The glasses came double-sealed, in a nice semi-rigid plastic snapcase with a cleaning cloth tucked inside. They fit perfect, right out of the box. It only took a few minutes to get used to the feel of the non-rigid bows. After using these for a couple of months I am sold. Enough to buy 2 more pair and recommend them to friends at work who were also shopping for readers and asked about these. The bows are snug without feeling like they're crushing your head. I can shake my head around and these glasses stay put. I hardly notice theyâ€™re on; the exception being the metal piece that secure the lenses to the nose piece. (It took a while to get used to it, as my eye kept getting drawn to the metallic glint in the upper corner of my vision. Within a few hours' worth of working at my computer Iâ€™d gotten used to it and don't even notice anymore. The rubbery bows look weird when the glasses are sitting on my desk but once they're on they flatten right out and look just like any other readers. Style is obviously very subjective but for the price, clarity, convenience and function I think they're a terrific alternative to 'traditional' readers.

Pleasantly surprised is an understatement. It seems like some member of my lineal ancestry has always been a watchmaker. The mantel fell to me some years ago. So, I'll add technical information to this review. The Parnis watch referred to as a Portugal style is a misnomer. I believe the name is a take-off on IWC's Portuguese Chronograph. In the purest sense its a "bilateral chronograph design".

I bought three of these and disassembled one to aide in writing this review. This watch in my opinion is one of the best Asian watches you will find. While it may look like a clone to an uninformed observer, it's not. It's a great watch. It comes off as an affordable luxury Swiss class and perhaps you'd expect to find a cheap Chinese watch. Not so. The movement is a Sea-Gull 2542, which would pass the COSC (Official Swiss Chronometer Testing Institute) standards. The case is high tensile strength, machine method produced and marine grade stainless steel. The manufacturer produced the crystals with a combination of fused sapphire and mineral glass for clarity and resistance to scratching.

If the technical stuff doesn't matter to you that's OK. Imagine a watch that would cost 20 times as much if it came from Europe.
